title: Measuring individual contributions to team success in professional road cycling
abstract: arXiv:2602.11831v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Assessing individual contributions within teams remains a fundamental challenge. This issue is particularly important in professional road cycling, where personal success hinges on a combination of individual talent and collective effort. Current points-based rankings disproportionately reward team leaders, undervaluing those who contribute through collaborative roles. To address this issue, we propose a flexible framework for collaborative contribution within professional cycling teams that combines individual performance, race participation, and a team-based credit-allocation system. Using data from the 2023 season, we show that our framework identifies meaningful differences in rider contribution that existing ranking systems fail to capture. translated_title: 测量职业公路自行车运动中个人对团队成功的贡献
translated_abstract: 评估团队内个人的贡献始终是一个根本性挑战。这一问题在职业公路自行车运动中尤为重要，因为个人的成功取决于个人天赋与集体努力的结合。目前基于积分的排名系统过度奖励车队领骑，低估了那些通过协作角色做出贡献的车手。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个灵活的职业自行车队协作贡献评估框架，该框架结合了个人表现、比赛参与度以及基于车队的贡献分配系统。利用2023赛季的数据，我们证明了该框架能够识别出现有排名系统无法捕捉的车手贡献的显著差异。随后，我们为该框架选择了一组参数配置，使其与《职业自行车经理》游戏中的车手评估高度契合，并对个人表现、比赛参与等因素赋予相同权重。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合个人表现、比赛参与和团队贡献分配系统的灵活框架，用于更公平地衡量职业公路自行车赛中车手对团队成功的个人贡献，弥补了现有积分排名系统低估协作型车手价值的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a flexible framework combining individual performance, race participation, and team-based credit allocation to more fairly measure individual contributions to team success in professional road cycling, addressing how existing points-based rankings undervalue riders in collaborative roles.
